summary: The reader has done an undergraduate computer science degree: asymptotic analysis and recurrences, basic algorithms (including schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication and the idea of the FFT), discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, primes, the Chinese remainder theorem, permutations, bit operations), and first-year linear algebra (matrices, rank, invertibility, subspaces). They know complex numbers, polynomials and basic Turing machines with tapes. They have not studied abstract algebra beyond rings as a name, tensor products, Nussbaumer or Schönhage–Strassen transforms, or any research-level multiplication algorithm.

known.name: Logarithms and iterated logarithms
known.gloss: The base-2 logarithm lg n, its powers (lg n)^c, and its basic identities.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Integers written in base 2 or another radix as digit strings, with bitwise operations such as XOR.

known.name: Schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication
known.gloss: Classical O(n^2) digit-by-digit multiplication and the divide-and-conquer O(n^1.585) improvement.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform algorithm
known.gloss: The O(N log N) divide-and-conquer evaluation of a discrete Fourier transform of length N.

known.name: Convolution
known.gloss: The sequence whose entries are sums of products of entries of two sequences with indices adding, cyclically or not.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and congruences
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers with equality taken up to a fixed modulus.

known.name: Primes and coprimality
known.gloss: Prime numbers, pairwise coprime integers, and the greatest common divisor.

known.name: Chinese remainder theorem
known.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, residues modulo each determine a unique residue modulo their product.

known.name: Matrices, rank and invertibility
known.gloss: Linear algebra over the rationals: matrices as linear maps, products, inverses, rank and triangular form.

known.name: Vector spaces and subspaces
known.gloss: Spans, subspaces, bases and changes of basis in finite-dimensional vector spaces.

known.name: Permutations
known.gloss: Bijective rearrangements of a finite index set and their matrix form.

known.name: Floor, ceiling and rounding
known.gloss: Rounding a real number down, up or to the nearest integer.

known.name: Recursion and recurrence relations
known.gloss: Analysing the cost of an algorithm that calls itself on smaller inputs by solving a recurrence.

known.name: Fixed-point and dyadic arithmetic
known.gloss: Representing numbers as integers scaled by a power of two, with bounded truncation error.

known.name: Complex conjugate and modulus
known.gloss: The conjugate and absolute value of a complex number, and complex numbers with integer real and imaginary parts.

known.name: Cartesian products and multi-indexing
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by tuples and the product of index sets.

known.name: Linear-time scans and tape sorting
known.gloss: Standard Turing machine operations such as copying, scanning and moving data between tapes in time linear or near-linear in length.

known.name: Deterministic computation and time complexity classes
known.gloss: Deterministic machines whose cost is the worst-case number of steps as a function of input size.

known.name: Geometric and power-of-two parameter manipulation
known.gloss: Routine manipulation of powers of two, exponents and geometric sums.
